Class Date

java.lang.Object
com.example.software_meth_3_javafx.util.Date
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Date>
public class Date extends Object implements Comparable<Date>
A Date class that represents a calendar date in mm/dd/yyyy format. Provides validation, string conversion, equality, and comparison methods.
Author:
Alec Cotler
